readings: Join each scanconservation record to its site via zoneref = zoneregistry, and group by the site's insurstat, with NULL insurstat as its own group. For each group, count the distinct sites that have at least one conservation record (COUNT DISTINCT zoneref). Show insurstat, that distinct-site count, and its share of the sum of the counts over all groups, as an unrounded fraction.

Join each scanconservation record to its site via zoneref = zoneregistry, and group by the site's insurstat, with NULL insurstat as its own group. For each group, count the conservation records (rows), so a site with several conservation records is counted once per record. Show insurstat, that record count, and its share of the sum of the counts over all groups, as an unrounded fraction.
queries:
SELECT s.insurstat,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref)) OVER () AS share
FROM scanconservation c
JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.insurstat;

SELECT s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM scanconservation c
JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.insurstat
